name: Intel Xeon 6972P (Granite Rapids-AP, 96-core, 12-channel DDR5 host CPU)
memory_bandwidth_basis: DERIVED, not a printed Intel bandwidth. ARK lists 12 memory channels and DDR5-6400. 12 x 8 x 6.4 = 614.4 GB/s theoretical peak per socket at 1 DPC. SST-PP also exposes a 400 W / 2.0 GHz profile; the stored TDP is the 500 W Server Mode profile.
notes: 96-core Granite Rapids-AP. Same 12-channel socket as 6980P, fewer cores, same 500 W TDP. Wikipedia's SKU table truncates this row (TDP cell missing); ARK is authoritative: TDP 500 W, 12 channels, 3.9 GHz max turbo. MLPerf v6.1 Red Hat + Intel 2S 6972P: llama3.1-8b INT8 1507.21 tok/s Offline / 644.788 tok/s Server, aggregate. vram_gb null (ARK max 3 TB).
